title: Neuro-Kurisu SUPER — reconciled weighted implementation roadmap scorecard — WorkPass38
baseArchive: Neuro_Kurisu_WORKPASS37_2026-10-13.zip + append-only ActionGateway receipt archive and concurrency-safe bounded hot-ledger compaction
method: WorkPass38 adds a file-backed append-only JSONL archive for completed ActionGateway receipts. Appends are checksummed and fsync-completed before a receipt is removed from hot state; same-key replays are read by indexed file offset after restart. Keyed requests require an installed durable persister and same-key concurrency is reserved before the first await. Archive plus gateway regressions pass 17/17. Individually completed gates: runtime typecheck, server smoke, release metadata 34/34, metadata contract 6/6, browser-smoke verdict 51/51, UI/API linkage, assets, architecture, hygiene, syntax, MemoryOS2 compatibility, action cost, StableSerialization and WILL/Lumina/Hexis/Letta/Conscio integration. Vite build remains blocked by absent app/node_modules (spawn vite ENOENT); remote provider receipts, browser Live2D E2E, labeled temporal retrieval holdout, clean-room rollback and soak remain open. Retrieval candidate stays not-promoted because synthetic uplift is zero.

workstreams.name: Canonical source lineage and single-owner architecture
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 remains the sole writable owner. WorkPass31 centralizes all current production mutation classes behind MemoryFabric and persists a bounded receipt ledger through ordinary state migration; legacy direct-write adapter methods remain only for historical consumers.

workstreams.name: Runtime integration, API/UI routes and smoke/linkage coverage
workstreams.rationale: Runtime/server integration, route linkage and focused app script smoke pass; release metadata is synchronized to 35.60.0/schema 225. Full dependency-installed React/Vite build and real desktop/mobile browser Live2D E2E remain open.

workstreams.name: Memory 2.0, retrieval/admission and benchmark evidence
workstreams.rationale: MemoryOS2 canonical retrieval and bounded semantic path remain in place; WorkPass37 fixes the timestamp semantics of the synthetic benchmark. Current candidate is not promoted because synthetic recall uplift is zero; independent labelled temporal holdout and actual local model inference remain open.

workstreams.name: Agency, action schema, execution, outcome and reafference
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass38 eliminates silent loss of completed ActionGateway keys by fsync-archiving receipts before hot-ledger eviction. Same-key concurrency is reserved before async lookup, no-persister execution fails closed, and corruption/torn-tail/restart behavior is covered. Actual remote provider reconciliation and end-to-end device receipts remain open.

workstreams.name: Portable subject continuity and social/known-entity dossier
workstreams.rationale: Read-only dossier and fidelity contracts are present; browser-backed corrections and behavioral equivalence remain open.

workstreams.name: External transport, SDK, idempotency and replay
workstreams.rationale: Local transport idempotency now has a shared durable ActionGateway receipt archive for file-backed runtime state. Remote delivery guarantees, provider reconnect and external ACK/reconciliation proof remain open.

workstreams.name: Research promotion and controlled experiments
workstreams.rationale: WorkPass25 supplies a deterministic private-first temperature-scaling fitter with a group-disjoint validation fold, version/dataset-bound artifact contract, NLL/Brier/ECE eligibility thresholds and provenance propagation into evidence/restore. This is an implemented pipeline only: the real pinned pretrained model and independent final holdout have not been run.

workstreams.name: Release durability: build, E2E, rollback, soak, SBOM/provenance
workstreams.rationale: Release metadata and operational readiness reporting improved; dependency-complete app install/build, browser E2E, clean-room restore/rollback, soak and final SBOM/provenance remain open.
